turns.userText: Create nums.txt containing the numbers 1 to 5, one per line. Then create sum.txt containing only the sum (15), computed by actually running a python3 script. Done when sum.txt contains 15.

cd /root/bench/matrix-pi/qwen3.8-max && printf '1
2
3
4
5
' > nums.txt && python3 -c "print(sum(int(l) for l in open('nums.txt') if l.strip()))" > sum.txt
